# Project Kestrel

Project Kestrel moved the network's bibliographic records, item records, and patron accounts out of the Bookwright system and onto Fernbank, the shared platform run by the Lakes Consortium. Bookwright had served the five branches since 2009, and its vendor ended support at the close of 2025.

## Scope

- About 410,000 bibliographic records and 690,000 item records from all five branches.
- 38,000 active patron accounts, with their holds, loans, and blocks.
- Local subject headings for regional history, which Fernbank does not carry by default.

## Timeline

The data load ran during the cutover week of March 9, 2026, while the branches circulated offline. Fernbank went live on March 16.

## Owners

[[Odile Varga]] led the record cleanup and the field mapping. Teodor Quist handled the exports. Planning notes live in [[Records cutover planning, 2026-02-10]], and the lessons are in the [[Retrospective - Moving to Fernbank]].
